1: The company was founded in a small office in Peterborough, UK, in 1932
Caterpillar’s acquisition of Perkins in December 1997
2: Perkins is a world-leading supplier of off-highway diesel engines in the 4-2000 kW (5-2800 hp) market
Since 1997 Perkins has been owned by Caterpillar.
